items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: I once won a bet, Monk Rowe, in a car going to Atlantic City maybe fifteen years ago... I would have Monk Rowe select them for me.

ctx.x: My goodness. If you could put together a dream band, from all the people in the past, who would you put on there.
I would have Monk Rowe select them for me.
